title: helia acutangula
intro: Helia acutangula, commonly known as the Chinese thorowax or Chinese angelica tree, is a plant native to Asia and is used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Helia acutangula include its use in treating menstrual disorders, fever, and inflammation, as well as its potential to reduce blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. Therapeutically, Helia acutangula is used to warm the body, dispel cold, and relieve pain. The bioactive constituents of Helia acutangula include a range of compounds such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
